label: Matching design traits to manifests
subgoals: Summarize the design in the traits manifests use
Filter out skills whose hard requirements fail
Match the remaining manifests to the step's objective

label: Scoring the candidates
subgoals: Weight each eligible skill's strengths by the objective weights
Sum the weighted strengths into a score

label: When selection should trigger customization
subgoals: Recognize when no eligible skill scores well
Read repeated metric failures in the fast loop as a signal
Replace advertised strengths with measured ones
